records.trigger: Control-arm memory JSON leak: on the control arm, done_closure --json (and the other serialized surfaces) return a populated runtime-memory pack, letting a control-arm host read stored dev-memory content.
records.observedFailure: Under pre-fix (B-ab8d) code with LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM=control, done_closure --json returns memoryFreshnessPack.results.devMemoryEntryIds = ['9890b83','7ffe281','a4d08a8','148297b'] (non-empty) — a live control-arm memory leak.
